name: log2timeline/plaso
description: A Python-based super-timeline forensic engine that automatically generates comprehensive timelines from system logs, file metadata, and forensic artifacts. Extensible with custom parsers and widely used as the backend for Timesketch.
score_rationale: Essential forensic timeline generation engine with 2k stars and a January 2026 release, serving as the standard backend for super-timeline-based DFIR workflows.
